fields.name: Resin Coated Sand (RCS)
fields.short_description: Premium resin coated silica sand for shell moulding and foundry core casting.
fields.description: Vetal Sand Solutions provides high-performance Resin Coated Sand engineered specifically for shell moulding, core making, and high-precision casting. Coated with specialized phenolic resin for superior tensile strength, low gas evolution, and thermal shock resistance.
fields.specifications:
AFS Grain Fineness: 55-65
Resin Content: 2.5% - 3.5%
Transverse Strength: >28 kg/cm²
Loss on Ignition: 2.8% - 3.8%
fields.applications: Shell moulding, core making for automotive engine blocks, pumps, valves, and precision iron castings.

fields.name: High Purity Quartz Silica Sand
fields.short_description: Ultra-pure 99.5%+ SiO2 white quartz sand for solar glass, optical glass, and advanced ceramics.
fields.description: Refined high-purity quartz silica sand featuring minimum 99.5% SiO2 content and ultra-low iron oxide (Fe2O3 < 0.015%). Processed through multiple washing and magnetic separation stages to deliver maximum optical transmission and chemical purity.
fields.specifications:
SiO2: 99.6% min
Fe2O3: < 0.015%
Al2O3: < 0.15%
Moisture: < 0.1%
Grain Size: 100-300 microns
fields.applications: Solar photovoltaic glass, laboratory glassware, optical fiber, premium sanitaryware, and electronics filler.
fields.industries: Glass Manufacturing, Solar Energy, Ceramics, Electronics

fields.name: Water Filtration Silica Gravel & Sand
fields.short_description: Naturally washed, rounded quartz silica gravel and multi-grade sand for municipal and industrial water filtration.
fields.description: Washed, sub-angular to rounded natural quartz filtration sand and support gravel compliant with IS:8419 standards. Provides exceptional turbidity removal, extended filter run times, and high chemical resistance against acids and alkalis in ETP and water treatment plants.
fields.specifications:
Effective Size (D10): 0.45mm - 0.55mm
Uniformity Coefficient: < 1.4
Specific Gravity: 2.65
Acid Solubility: < 1.0%
fields.applications: Multi-media pressure sand filters, rapid gravity filters, industrial ETP/STP plants, swimming pool filtration, and borewell gravel packing.
fields.industries: Water Filtration, Municipal Utilities, Chemical Processing

fields.name: Epoxy Flooring Grade Silica Sand
fields.short_description: Kiln-dried, spherical silica aggregate for self-leveling epoxy flooring and anti-skid coatings.
fields.description: Specialized kiln-dried silica sand granules graded for seamless epoxy and polyurethane resin systems. Clean, dust-free, and moisture-free aggregate providing excellent mechanical wear resistance, anti-skid grip, and compressive strength for industrial shop floors.
fields.specifications:
Mesh Size: 30/80 Mesh (0.18mm - 0.60mm)
Moisture Content: < 0.2%
Mohs Hardness: 7.0
Cleanliness: Washed & Kiln Dried
fields.applications: Heavy-duty industrial flooring, warehouse ramps, pharmaceutical cleanrooms, car park decks, and decorative resin screeds.

fields.name: Abrasive Sand Blasting Silica Sand
fields.short_description: Sharp angular crystalline silica grit for surface rust removal, paint stripping, and shot blasting.
fields.description: High-hardness crystalline silica sand abrasive with sharp, multi-faceted angular particles designed for compressed air sandblasting. Quickly removes heavy rust, mill scale, and industrial coatings to achieve SA 2.5 surface profile finish on structural steel.
fields.specifications:
Grain Size: 20/40 Mesh (0.42mm - 0.84mm)
Bulk Density: 1.55 g/cm³
Angularity: Sharp Angular
Hardness: 7 Mohs
fields.applications: Surface preparation, rust and paint stripping from ship hulls, bridges, storage tanks, and structural steel fabrication.
fields.industries: Foundries & Castings, Construction & Masonry, Marine & Shipyard
